newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Huge drug haul seized on fishing boat off Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Huge drug haul seized on fishing boat off Colombia.

text.p: An international anti-drug force seized at least six tons of cocaine from a fishing boat sailing in Colombian waters bound for Mexico, police sources said on Wednesday.

Colombian and Ecuadorean police, together with U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration agents, boarded the 635-ton vessel on Tuesday and discovered the cocaine concealed in fuel tanks. Two people were arrested in the joint operation, dubbed Operation Shark.
A Colombian police spokesman said small launches had loaded the drug shipment on to the Ecuadorean registered fishing boat off Colombia's Pacific coast.
The craft was towed to shore and is currently being held in the Ecuadorean port of La Esmeralda.
DEA agents estimate Colombia supplies 80 percent of the world's cocaine. The country's drug cartels are also becoming major players in the high-grade heroin market.
